syncStatus.local: Data is saved locally in the browser. Sign in with Google to sync to the cloud.
syncStatus.saved: Data saved to the cloud. It will be available on all your devices.

budget.label: Budget
budget.signInRequired: Sign in with Google to create multiple budgets.
budget.signInRequiredDelete: Sign in with Google to delete budgets.
budget.signInRequiredEdit: Sign in with Google to edit budget names.
budget.description: Free version allows up to 3 budgets. Main budget (Main/Основний) cannot be deleted.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete budget?
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete budget "{{budgetName}}"? This action cannot be undone.

currency.description: Select 3 currencies to track. Each currency can only be selected once.

changeConfirm.title: Are you sure?
changeConfirm.message: You have some calculations in this currency. After changing the currency, they will be erased. Continue?

exchangeRates.title: 💱 Exchange Rates
exchangeRates.description: Exchange rates for each currency pair. Buy - rate for buying currency, Sell - rate for selling currency.

autoFetch.label: Auto fetch (NBU)
autoFetch.hint: When enabled, on page refresh the app automatically triggers "Update rates from NBU".

region.label: Region for local rate
region.selectedHint: {{country}} uses {{currency}}. Rate refresh includes this currency.
region.noRegionHint: Choose a region to include its local currency during rate refresh.

localInteraction.title: For local interaction
localInteraction.description: You can save JSON to disk and then import it back at any time.

clearAllConfirm.title: Are you sure?
clearAllConfirm.message: This will clear all entered data and reset the selected file (the file will not be deleted from disk)!

clearAllDaysConfirm.title: Are you sure?
clearAllDaysConfirm.message: This will clear all data for all days (transactions, descriptions), but will keep starting balances and settings!

startNewMonth.title: Start new month
startNewMonth.message: All data for days will be deleted, and the current budget will become the starting balance for the next month. Budget date will automatically change to the next month. Continue?

budgetMonth.label: Budget Month
budgetMonth.tooltip: Budget month. When importing a file, the date is set from the file. When clicking "Start new month", the date automatically changes to the next month.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your data with End-to-End encryption. Password is stored only in memory and never sent to the server.

deleteAccount.title: Are you sure?
deleteAccount.warning: This action is irreversible. All your budgets and settings will be deleted from Google servers. If you don't have a local copy (JSON), it will be impossible to recover the data.
deleteAccount.irreversible: This action is irreversible. All your data will be permanently deleted.
deleteAccount.error: ❌ Error deleting account. Please try again.
deleteAccount.requiresRecentLogin: ⚠️ For security, recent login is required. Please log out and log in again, then try to delete the account.

budgetStatus.title: Current budget status
budgetStatus.criticalDaysHint: Days when your balance is projected to be at its lowest point.
budgetStatus.criticalMonthsHint: Months in this 12-month window when the rolling projected balance is at its lowest.

transaction.amountError: Enter a valid amount greater than 0

analytics.title: Analytics & Insights
analytics.streakNoData: Add transactions to see your streak

overviewDashboard.title: Monthly overview
overviewDashboard.subtitle: A quick read on how this budget month is moving.
overviewDashboard.savingsRateHelper: net cash flow as a share of income

transactionExplorer.title: Transaction explorer
transactionExplorer.subtitle: Find and review transactions for the selected budget month.
transactionExplorer.emptyDescription: Try changing the filters or add transactions in the daily table.

footer.feedback: 🐛 Found a bug? / Have a suggestion?

enable.title: Enable Encryption
enable.message: Set a password to encrypt your data. If you forget this password, data cannot be recovered!

disable.title: Disable Encryption
disable.message: Enter your current password to disable encryption. After this, data will be stored in plain text.

unlock.title: Enter password to unlock
unlock.message: Your data is encrypted. Enter your password to access it.

budget.cannotDeleteLast: Cannot delete the last budget. At least one budget must remain.

rates.noCurrenciesToUpdate: ℹ️ No currencies to update (only base currency selected)
rates.errorLoading: ❌ Error loading NBU rates. Check your internet connection or enter rates manually.

importExport.fileSavedInfo: ✅ File saved: {{filename}}. 💡 To choose folder: Settings → General → Downloads → "Always ask you where to save files"

importModal.title: Import Budget
importModal.selectAction: Choose how to import this budget:
importModal.hintDeleteBudget: Delete one of the existing budgets to create a new one.
importModal.hintOrLogout: Or log out and continue using.

monthlyPlanner.title: 12-month plan
monthlyPlanner.subtitle: Plan future income and expenses on a rolling 12-month window — projected balance rolls forward from the current budget.
monthlyPlanner.empty: No planned transactions for this month yet.
monthlyPlanner.deleteMessage: This planned transaction will be removed from the forecast.

clearMonthConfirm.title: Clear all planned transactions for this month?
clearMonthConfirm.message: All planned transactions for this month will be removed. This cannot be undone.

futureYearConfirm.title: Plan into a future year?
futureYearConfirm.message: You're moving the planning window to {{range}}. This expands what we'll need to store for your account — please confirm you want to plan that far ahead.

modal.multiMonthHint: Select one or more months — the same transaction will be added to each (useful for recurring items).
modal.editLockHint: When editing, the original month is locked.
modal.noSelectableMonths: No future months available in this window.

warning.title: ⚠️ Warning! This month has fewer days.
warning.message: Data for days that exceed this month will be deleted.
